review_rounds.behavioral: Separate reviews of drafts, blind comparisons, and final regressions

publication_note: Public export preserves exact response text, hashes, verdicts, scores and rationales. Environment-specific paths, agent workspace identifiers and private file-service links are omitted. Historical timing fields are omitted because they do not establish generation latency. Original review filenames in revision history are historical labels; the published response archive contains the corresponding primary reviews.
limits: One assistant model family, with unknown observed model identifiers.
Fresh context per batch; four to sixteen requests shared a batch.
Model semantic grading; no human comprehension or automatic activation study.
All final cases are regression data after prior inspection.
The six-prompt comparison is descriptive, not a general ranking.
Direct Codex CLI initialization failed in the creation environment; live answers used collaboration agents. Adapter checks were synthetic.

accepted.issue: Source inspection is different from observed execution
accepted.change: Qualify behavior dependent on unseen inputs, configuration or runtime; never imply execution from reading.

accepted.issue: Audience assumption could conflict with expert adaptation
accepted.change: Use the smart newcomer default only when no audience signals exist.

accepted.issue: Some opening wording could force examples
accepted.change: Make an example conditional on its explanatory value.

accepted.issue: Mechanism wording is narrow for arguments
accepted.change: Include relevant reasoning as well as mechanisms.

design_review_1.status: Integrated in v2 after v1 outputs were frozen

v1_behavior_review.notes: No behavioral failures found. Optional polish suggestions retained in original review; no answer-specific patches.

v2.changes: Four accepted design-review corrections; no scenario answers or keywords added to the skill.

minor_findings: S17 pressure-balance condition implicit; separate blind Chinese review found no material omission for the requested audience.
S34 introduced an unexplained technical term in a comparison.

v3.change: Replace generic jargon checklist item with a separate sweep across comparisons, caveats, tables and examples; define, replace, or remove each unfamiliar term. No scenario-specific terms added.
v3.reason: S34 terminology omission in secondary content despite overall passing score.

v4.reason: A separate terminology sweep did not reliably prevent unexplained terms in v3 S34 and H04; S16 also omitted a required distinction about change units.
changes: Prefer meaning before labels and make explicit that a condition using a term does not define the term.
Ground syntax vocabulary in visible source characters.
Apply quantity, baseline and unit explanations to numbers as well as formulas.
v4.test_scope: All 46 scenarios regenerated after freezing v4; previously inspected cases are regression tests, not new holdouts.

findings: S16 omitted the distinction between percentage points and relative percentage change.
S17 was judged partial for an implicit causal connection; an earlier draft’s similar bubble-based account had received a pass with a minor deduction, illustrating reviewer judgment.
S34 and H04 still introduced unexplained technical labels despite the separate terminology sweep.
v3_behavior_review.natural_cases: Six additional v3 natural responses are included in the final anonymized review.

minor_findings: S32 has one context-dependent wording ambiguity about comparing density from mass alone; the reviewer deducted one clarity point.
v4_behavior_review.readiness: All 46 final regression cases pass the registered standard. The minor wording issue is documented; passing does not mean perfect prose or guaranteed human comprehension.
